docs.title: SQA Documentation
docs.text: Welcome to the SQA team's central knowledge base. Browse by category using the left sidebar, or use the search bar at the top.

docs.title: How to Read a Document
docs.text: Click any document in the sidebar. It opens directly in your browser — no download needed.

docs.title: How to Download
docs.text: Every document page has a ⬇ Download .docx button to get the original Word file.
